label: preparing
what: A coordinated residents' gathering at eighteen sharp in the great hall, with bread, lanterns, an escort and a private community presentation. The gathering itself was disclosed, but presentation details remain concealed and early arrival was discouraged. It may celebrate my forty years of service, though that purpose is only a guess. Innkeeper, freight and builder are coordinating supplies and escort; baker appears involved in bread preparation, and secretary knowingly assists scheduling and communications.
